releaseNotes:
Table board first: see every table's order with Details, Edit, Switch, Add and Cancel
Switch table right from the table card
Resume an order that wasn't placed yet, per table
Take Out orders on the menu tablet and the cashier (Take Out #1, #2, …)
New category cards on the menu with icons and item counts
Cart: close button, total at the bottom, and a fire animation on the cart button
New cashier screen: Unsettled, History and Activity tabs with the full order breakdown
Cashier can Add, Edit, Switch table and Cancel orders
Settle with discount, amount received, change and reference no.
Activity log of every order change for the day
Order alerts on the cashier with voice: new order, additional order, edit, cancel and table switch
Stop Alert and mute button; alerts wake the screen even when the app is closed
Offline mode: orders are saved on the tablet and sync once the internet is back
Orders still reach the cashier over the shop WiFi without internet
Live clock and new Ready to Settle / Collected Today cards on the cashier
One-tap EN / KR language switch in the header
Refresh button with loading animation and blurred pop-up backgrounds
Check for updates in Settings
Quick login with the account picker; Menu Tablet and Cashier accounts work on several tablets at once
Fixes: edit alerts showing every item as removed, language switch jumping back to Unsettled, cashier take-out showing as Dine In
